shortlist.name: PCL region-grow cuboid (Ozkan/Pochtrager, no remote coplanar merge)
Pointcept PTv3/PointGroup; BIMStruct3D zero-shot as control only
Open3D-ML RandLA-Net or KPConv, S3DIS weights

finding: No surveyed method is scored beat_shortlist. None was run. Add sequential cuboid RANSAC (pyRANSAC-3D v0.7.0) after the rank-1 plate peel. Add a SAM 2 mask lift only when a registered image exists. Leave the third slot empty. Do not drop ranks 1-5.

yolo_section.summary: YOLO is an image detector. It does not emit a stud instance, a 3D oriented box, or lean from a point cloud. RGB helps only as a proposal whose points are then boxed by the shared post-step. YOLO3D and BEVFusion regress a bird's-eye heading for driving, which is not stud lean.

vuforia_section.summary: Model Targets track one CAD-matched object and return that CAD's axis-aligned box in the camera frame. Area Targets localize in a scanned room. Neither instances a wall of 2x4s nor reports lean against the floor or gravity.

add.condition: Always, on the same clouds as rank 1, after the same plate peel.
Only when the capture already has a registered image. Skip on a pure LAS/PLY.

candidates.name: pyRANSAC-3D v0.7.0 sequential cuboid
candidates.what_it_does: Fits one oriented cuboid (three orthogonal faces) to a point array and returns center, extents, and axes. A wall scan would need our plate peel, inlier removal, and a 2x4 section reject.
candidates.can_instance_2x4: Unknown. One call fits one cuboid and can swallow coplanar studs. Unmeasured on a bare wall.
candidates.obb: Yes. center, extents, and axes. Not locked to global Z.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: Not native. Long axis can take the shared floor-normal angle. Gravity is the later repaint.
candidates.fit_why: Emits the box and a free axis the scorecard needs. Unmeasured, and the default threshold is not a stud prior.
candidates.reported_accuracy: None on studs. Do not treat the library default thresh of 0.05 as a calibrated stud tolerance.

candidates.name: SAM 2 image mask lifted onto points, then the shared box
candidates.what_it_does: Promptable image and video segmentation. A mask is useful only after a person or another detector names the stud. Lifted points then use the OpenWall box and angle.
candidates.input_modality: Registered RGB (or video). Not a pure point cloud.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 for checkpoints, demo, and training code. Demo fonts SIL OFL 1.1. cctorch BSD-3-Clause.
candidates.can_instance_2x4: Unknown. SAM 2 has no stud class. Zero-shot stud accuracy was not tested.
candidates.obb: No. Image mask only. The 3D box is our post-step.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: No. Angle stays on the lifted points.
candidates.fit_why: Might separate touching members when a photo exists. Does not replace the box or the angle.
candidates.reported_accuracy: No stud metric found.

candidates.name: Ultralytics YOLO11 / YOLOv8 / YOLO-World
candidates.what_it_does: Image detection, instance masks, 2D keypoints, and 2D oriented boxes. YOLO-World adds a text prompt. Not a point-cloud stud model.
candidates.pricing: AGPL at no fee if the whole application is AGPL. Enterprise price unknown (quote).
candidates.can_instance_2x4: Only as a 2D box or mask. Wall-scale stud accuracy unknown. COCO mAP is not a stud score.
candidates.obb: 2D image OBB only (aerial-style). Not a 3D stud box.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: No.
candidates.open_or_closed: open under AGPL; closed use needs Enterprise
candidates.last_updated_or_paper_year: YOLO11 docs read 2026-09-25 (software year 2024 on the citation).
candidates.fit_why: A registered photo could propose instances. The lean still comes from points. AGPL is a poor fit for closed-source TruePlank.
candidates.reported_accuracy: Hugging Face YOLO11 card: COCO mAP 54.7 at 0.5:0.95. Not studs.

candidates.name: YOLO3D (Ali et al., ECCV 2018 workshop)
candidates.what_it_does: YOLO v2 on a bird's-eye LiDAR image. Regresses a 3D box and a heading in that plane.
candidates.input_modality: LiDAR projected to a bird's-eye image. KITTI.
candidates.license: Paper is a CVF open-access PDF. Code license not fetched.
candidates.can_instance_2x4: No stud class. Domain is driving.
candidates.obb: Yes, a 3D box for KITTI objects, with bird's-eye yaw.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: Bird's-eye heading is rotation about vertical, not lean of a stud axis.
candidates.fit_why: Wrong objects and the wrong angle.
candidates.reported_accuracy: KITTI only. Not copied as a stud score.

candidates.name: BEVFusion
candidates.what_it_does: Camera and LiDAR fusion in a bird's-eye grid for 3D detection and map segmentation.
candidates.license: Paper PDF. Code license not fetched.
candidates.can_instance_2x4: No. Driving classes.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: Bird's-eye vehicle heading, not stud lean.
candidates.fit_why: Driving fusion. No stud class.
candidates.reported_accuracy: nuScenes mAP in the paper. Not copied.

candidates.name: Xie and Alwisy 2026 WFC 6D pose (YOLOv8 detect plus point-cloud pose)
candidates.what_it_does: Close-range 6D pose of one 2x4 from ZED 2i RGB-D. YOLOv8 detects. A geometry-prior pose refiner follows. Code for the pose method is not in the public repo.
candidates.input_modality: RGB-D of a single stud. 288 turntable views.
candidates.license: Dataset README license heading was empty. Unknown.
candidates.pricing: Dataset host is Dropbox. No fee stated. Archive 10.65 GB was not downloaded.
candidates.can_instance_2x4: One stud per frame in a controlled setup. Not a wall of studs. Pose code listed as coming soon.
candidates.obb: 6D pose of a measured stud model, which implies a box. Not demonstrated on a registered wall cloud.
candidates.angle_vs_gravity_or_floor: Full rotation error versus their manual pose. Mean 1.43 degrees, median 1.00 degrees. Their strict bar is 2 degrees and 20 mm. Not floor-relative lean of a wall stud.
candidates.open_or_closed: paper plus dataset; fitter code not released
candidates.fit_why: The only public 2x4 pose table found. Scene, code, and 1-degree rotation keep it off the bake-off.
candidates.reported_accuracy: README Table 2 rotation mean/median degrees: theirs 1.43/1.00; FoundationPose 7.25/5.30; SAM-6D 9.18/2.90; MegaPose 5.16/2.01; plane-fitting baseline 28.28/23.93. Table 3: 73.61 percent within 20 mm and 2 degrees. ADD-S mean 4.80 mm. LinkedIn grasp and 99.82 percent claims were not in the README and are excluded.

candidates.last_updated_or_paper_year: Scored in the 2026 WFC README. Original paper years not re-fetched.

candidates.reported_accuracy: See B6 table. No separate stud-wall metric.
